tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background for every screen, customer and staff. Also the fill of the light button and the text colour on olive fills.

tokens.name: cream-pressed
tokens.usage: Fill of the light button while pressed. Never a background for large areas.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Section panels and cards sitting on cream: menu item cards, cat cards, the kitchen board columns.

tokens.name: paw-faint
tokens.usage: Faint paw-print trails on the cream page background. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: The brand colour, exact from the kit. Cat silhouettes, doodles, dots, and display headings 24px+ on cream (3.74:1). On panel it is only 2.88:1, so headings on panel use olive-dark instead.

tokens.name: olive-strong
tokens.usage: Accessible olive for anything small: primary button fill, light-button label, links, chips and prices. Cream on it is 5.95:1; it reads 4.58:1 on panel and 5.95:1 on cream.

tokens.name: olive-dark
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of the primary button (exact from the kit) and headings on panel (6.86:1). Cream on it is 8.91:1.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Main ink: body text and the hero walking cat. 9.27:1 on cream, 7.15:1 on panel.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text such as descriptions, timestamps and helper text. 6.11:1 on cream, 4.71:1 on panel.

tokens.name: on-olive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on olive-strong and olive-dark fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines that carry no meaning. Form-field borders use olive instead (3.74:1 on cream).

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled buttons, exact from the kit.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Label on a disabled fill. Deliberately low contrast, as in the kit; disabled controls are exempt from contrast rules.

tokens.name: ginger
tokens.usage: Ginger-cat accent, exact from the kit's paw. Shapes only (paw peeks, small blocks). Never text: 2.15:1 on cream.

tokens.name: ginger-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the ginger family: the 'Napping' sold-out label and the 'New' badge. 5.53:1 on cream, 4.26:1 on panel, so use it on cream only.

tokens.name: ginger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of ginger badges; ginger-ink text on it.

tokens.name: calico-brown
tokens.usage: Paw-pad brown in the calico and ginger paw peeks. Decoration only.

tokens.name: calico-tan
tokens.usage: Calico fur in the paw peek. Decoration only.

tokens.name: bean-pink
tokens.usage: Toe-bean pink in the black paw peek. Decoration only.

tokens.name: olive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of olive chips (veg, available, confirmed); olive-strong text on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and allergen warnings (contains nuts). 6.55:1 on cream. Always paired with an icon or a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error messages and allergen chips; danger text on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a 2px cream gap, then a solid 2px charcoal ring. 9.27:1 on cream, 7.15:1 on panel.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero only, in charcoal on cream.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section panel titles and menu category headings, centred in a panel like the kit's 'Buttons'.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card group titles and the table header on the QR menu.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: Menu item names, cat names on cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Double shot, velvety foam and a cocoa paw on top.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, in olive-strong. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: state-label
styles.usage: Light caption above a group of examples, as in the kit's 'Default / Hover' labels.

styles.name: script
styles.usage: One or two decorative words (meow, yawn, purr) beside a doodle. Never for information.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; page gutter at 360px.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section spacing on larger screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, item images inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards: menu items, cats, table tents.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Section panels, the bottom-sheet cart.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, tab and time slot. The kit is pill-shaped throughout.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered buttons and the floating cart bar.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (cart) rising from the screen edge.
